preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the size N of arrays A and B is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= abs(A[i]) <= 10**5 for A in As for i in range(len(A)))
preconditions.description: Each element of array A has an absolute value between 0 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= abs(B[i]) <= 10**5 for B in Bs for i in range(len(B)))
preconditions.description: Each element of array B has an absolute value between 0 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= K <= 10**9 for K in Ks)
preconditions.description: The number of allowed operations K is between 0 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The number of lines in the output matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_lines[i]) == max_interaction(A, B, K) for i, (A, B, K) in enumerate(zip(As, Bs, Ks)))
postconditions.description: Each line in the output is the maximum possible interaction value for the corresponding test case.
